cat.desc.FIH_MapEditor: Build, share and race your own maps.
cat.desc.FlippingIsHard_TAS_Tool: Recording and playback, savestates, frame advance and slow motion.
cat.desc.SkinChanger_FlippingIsHard: Replaces the phone charm and skins with your own models and textures.
cat.desc.FIH_Ghost: Race the ghosts of your PBs, spectate and share routes.
cat.desc.ChaosIsHard: Hotkey-triggered troll effects for streamers, synced across the lobby.
cat.desc.ChainedIsHard: Chains the whole lobby together, Chained Together style.
cat.desc.FIH-Korean-Translator: Translates the game's English text into Korean (Ctrl+K to toggle).
cat.desc.FIH-Photo-Mode: Hide the HUD, freeze time, free camera and FOV control; saves screenshots as PNG.
cat.desc.FIH-Text-Chat: Multiplayer text chat with commands, mentions, autocomplete and a profanity filter.
cat.desc.StickerSwap: Put your own picture on the back of your phone as a sticker (K to edit).
cat.desc.FirstPersonIsHard: First person camera that keeps the horizon level while the phone flips.

dlg.reinstall.title: Reinstall BepInEx

dlg.uninstall.title: Uninstall BepInEx

proton.title: Steam launch option (Proton)
